arguments.cmd:
cd /tmp/lenparam && for T in 1.26 0.84; do python3 -c "
src = open('model.scad').read()
import re
src = re.sub(r'cube\(\[5\.04, [0-9.]+, 19\.0\]\)', 'cube([5.04, $T, 19.0])', src)
open('model.scad','w').write(src)
print('set t=$T')
"
timeout 280 cadcheck behaviour --out-dir /tmp/lenparam/bout model.scad 2>&1 | grep -E 'force_n|strain_pct|z_strain_pct|past the|to ride over' | head -12
echo "===== t=$T done ====="
done
